svg.title: fastjson against stdjson: wall time −50%, better; peak memory +188%, worse.
svg.desc: fastjson against stdjson: wall time −50%, better; peak memory +188%, worse. Dot: effect against stdjson. Line: 98.75% interval. Shaded band: the smallest difference that matters. Wall time: median in s, lower is better, n = 10 per candidate; smallest difference that matters: 10%.
